content.short: ether.fi is a decentralized liquid restaking protocol where users maintain control of their keys and assets.
content.description:
ether.fi is a leading decentralized liquid staking and restaking protocol on Ethereum that prioritizes user sovereignty and security. It stands out in the ecosystem by being the first protocol to allow stakers to retain control of their private keys throughout the staking process, ensuring a truly non-custodial experience. By integrating natively with EigenLayer, ether.fi enables users to earn staking rewards while simultaneously participating in the restaking economy through its eETH token, maximizing yield without compromising on decentralization.

The protocol's architecture is built to be resilient and transparent, providing a robust infrastructure for institutional and retail participants alike. Beyond staking, ether.fi is expanding its ecosystem to include diverse financial services, such as automated yield strategies and cash accounts, all centered around its core liquid restaking primitive. As a cornerstone of the Ethereum staking landscape, ether.fi continues to innovate, bridging the gap between security, liquidity, and user-centric DeFi.
